mnemonic: Above, Lord of the Heavens. ʾ-L-H is the root of God and of any deity.

example.en: The Romans had a god of the sea.
There are many gods in the old stories.

mnemonic: Ruler Beyond Bounds. R-B-B is the root of the lord and master who owns and looks after.
Arrive Today, Yes! ʾ-T-Y is the root of coming and bringing.

example.en: The friend came in the evening.

mnemonic: Keep the Farmland coveRed. K-F-R first meant covering over, as a farmer covers seed; then covering up the truth: disbelief.

example.en: The king rejected the old gods.
Disbelief is the opposite of faith.
There was an unbeliever in the village.
He paid an atonement for his oath.

mnemonic: Nothing Feels Self-less. N-F-S is the root of the self, the soul and the breath that keeps it.
SHow Your Aims. SH-Y-ʾ is the root of a thing, and of willing it.

example.en: I have many things in the bag.
I'll see you tomorrow, God willing.

mnemonic: Help Direct You. H-D-Y is the root of guiding someone, and of the gift that leads to them.

example.en: The book is guidance for people.
I bought a gift for my mother.

words.meaning: to find the way, be guided

mnemonic: Awful DHeath Blow. ʿ-DH-B is the root of torment, and, oddly, of fresh sweet water.
KHnead, Lift, Quicken. KH-L-Q is the root of creating, and of the character one is made with.

example.en: God created the heavens and the earth.
He is a man of good character.

mnemonic: A Monarch Rules. ʾ-M-R is the root of commanding, and of the matter commanded.

example.en: The commander ordered the soldiers to wait.

mnemonic: News Brought Abroad. N-B-ʾ is the root of important news, and of the prophet who brings it.
After, KHeep Rear. ʾ-KH-R is the root of what comes after: the other one, the last one, the life hereafter.

example.en: The train was an hour late.

mnemonic: Down, Near, Within reach. D-N-W is the root of being near and low, and of this nearer world.

example.en: Life in this world is short.

mnemonic: Awesome, Zealous, Mighty. ʿ-Ẓ-M is the root of greatness, and of bone, the body's strong frame.

example.en: He is the greatest Arab poet.
He broke a bone in his hand.

mnemonic: Straight, Broad Lane. S-B-L is the root of the way and the path.

example.en: This is the way to success.
We are looking for new ways.

mnemonic: Quickly Lub-dub Beating. Q-L-B is the root of the heart, and of turning over, as the heart turns.

example.en: There was a coup in the country.

mnemonic: Sound, Lasting, Healthy. Ṣ-L-Ḥ is the root of being good and set right.
Wear Quilted Yokes. W-Q-Y is the root of guarding against harm, and of the mindful fear of God that guards the heart.

example.en: Be mindful of God in your work.

mnemonic: Words Assured, Delivered. W-ʿ-D is the root of promising.

example.en: The father promised his son a gift.
I have an appointment with the doctor.

mnemonic: Rice, Zucchini, Quinoa. R-Z-Q is the root of provision: what you are given to live on.

example.en: Our provision is in God's hands.
God blessed them with a son.

mnemonic: Grace For Regret. GH-F-R is the root of forgiving, originally covering over a fault.

example.en: The man asked forgiveness after his mistake.

mnemonic: Bright Sharp Retina. B-Ṣ-R is the root of seeing, with the eyes and with the mind.

example.en: He is a man of insight.

mnemonic: Food Spoils, Decays. F-S-D is the root of going bad and corruption.
Never Surrender, Rise. N-Ṣ-R is the root of helping someone to win, and of victory.

example.en: The friend stood by his friend.
The team won in the end.

mnemonic: Watching, Loyal, Yours. W-L-Y is the root of being near someone: a guardian, a friend, one in charge.

example.en: A child's father is his guardian.

mnemonic: Quarrels Turn Lethal. Q-T-L is the root of killing and of fighting.
Stoop, Join the Dust. S-J-D is the root of bowing down with the forehead to the ground.

example.en: The mosque is near the house.

mnemonic: Zero Kept, Wealth given. Z-K-W is the root of purity and of the alms that purify wealth.

example.en: Alms-giving is a pillar of Islam.

mnemonic: Nice And Mellow. N-ʿ-M is the root of blessing, comfort and softness; and of نَعَم, yes.
Just Zeal Yields. J-Z-Y is the root of giving back what someone deserves.

example.en: This is the reward of patience.
May God reward you with good.

mnemonic: Bring An envoy THere. B-ʿ-TH is the root of sending someone out, and of raising the dead.
Hope Lost, Killed. H-L-K is the root of perishing; and, more mildly, of using things up.
Tasty, Yummy, Brilliant. Ṭ-Y-B is the root of what is good and pleasant.

example.en: This is the tastiest food I've eaten.

mnemonic: Drifting, Lost, Lonely. Ḍ-L-L is the root of losing the way.

example.en: The boy got lost in the market.

mnemonic: Finer, Dearer, Leading. F-Ḍ-L is the root of what is extra and better: favour, merit, preference.
Attack, Dash, War. ʿ-D-W is the root of enmity, and of running at someone.

example.en: There is an old enmity between them.

mnemonic: A Job's Return. ʾ-J-R is the root of what is earned: a wage, a reward, a rent.

example.en: How much is the taxi fare?
Rent is expensive in the city.

mnemonic: Handsome, Splendid, Nice. Ḥ-S-N is the root of what is good and beautiful, and of doing good.

example.en: Kindness to a neighbour is a duty.
Every kind word is a good deed.

mnemonic: Admired, Zealous, Zenith. ʿ-Z-Z is the root of being mighty, honoured and dear.
Wholly Kept, Lean on. W-K-L is the root of trusting someone with your affairs.

example.en: Put your trust in God and begin.

mnemonic: Bring SHining Reports. B-SH-R is the root of the human being (seen by the skin), and of good news that shows on the face.
Notice: Danger Rising. N-DH-R is the root of warning, and of a solemn vow.

example.en: A warner came from the city.

mnemonic: Gone, Yet Believed. GH-Y-B is the root of being absent, out of sight.
Whispered, Heavenly, Inward. W-Ḥ-Y is the root of a message passed silently: inspiration and revelation.

example.en: The view gave me an idea.

mnemonic: Take Willing Action. Ṭ-W-ʿ is the root of willingly doing: obeying, and being able to.
Relaxed, Delighted, Yes. R-Ḍ-Y is the root of being pleased and content.

example.en: The father was pleased with his son.
I am satisfied with my work.

mnemonic: Bring Letters, Go. B-L-GH is the root of arriving at, and of conveying a message all the way.

example.en: He reached the age of twenty.
He reported the accident to the police.

mnemonic: Hearts Make Devotion. Ḥ-M-D is the root of praise; Muhammad and Ahmad mean "praised".
DHark Nasty Blot. DH-N-B is the root of a sin, a fault that trails after you like a tail.

example.en: The cat has a long tail.

mnemonic: Just Hustle Daily. J-H-D is the root of effort and striving.

example.en: The student worked hard at his studies.
